# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability or include personal, customer or financial data in a report.

Use this repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/Baraka-kileo/proofflow/security/advisories/new). Include the affected route or component, reproduction conditions, likely impact and a minimal proof of concept that contains no real customer information.

## Scope

This repository is a hackathon MVP and is not represented as independently certified for production financial services. The implemented security model and the remaining production controls are documented in [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md).
